title: Open a Windows laptop back panel

steps.instruction: Undo the two screws at the bottom of the back panel
steps.transcript: neeche ke do screw khol do

steps.instruction: Lift the back panel off the laptop
steps.warning: Careful, don't pull it by the ribbon cable

steps.instruction: Anyway that is enough about warranties
Pull the old RAM module out of its slot
Insert the new RAM module at an angle
Press it down until the clips snap
Refit the panel and screw it back in clockwise
Check that the panel sits flat
